title: Google vs Samsung vs Nvidia Offer
author: QPPN42
description:
Offer Evaluation offers

20 YOE, senior SE/ML background. Goal is maximum long-term wealth and a path toward Director/VP/CTO-level technology
contentPreview:
Offer Evaluation offers

20 YOE, senior SE/ML background. Goal is maximum long-term wealth and a path toward Director/VP/CTO-level technology
content:
#Offer Evaluation #offers

20 YOE, senior SE/ML background. Goal is maximum long-term wealth and a path toward Director/VP/CTO-level technology leadership.

1. Google Cloud - Customer Engineer

• Base: €130k
• Bonus: €60k
• Equity: €20k/year
• TCE: €202k
• IC role
• Strong Big Tech brand + equity. Role and funding secure. 
• Potential internal path: CE → CE Manager → Head of … / Director
• Concern: could remain senior IC for many years; management requires winning an internal leadership role

2. Samsung - Director Technology

• Base: €170k
• Bonus/LTI: €50k
• TCE: €220k
• 30 direct reports from day one
• Hiring/team-growth responsibility
• Global scope
• Budget/vendor responsibility
• Reports to VP → CTO
• Organization expected to grow. 
• Concern: less equity upside than Big Tech and actual org growth still needs to materialise. Role most risky if IT receives less budget.

3. NVIDIA - Solutions Architect

• Base: €110k
• Bonus: none
• Equity: €60k/year
• TCE: €170k
• IC role
• Excellent AI brand
• Strong potential equity upside
• Concern: another senior IC path rather than immediate leadership

I care less about maximizing TC for the next 1–2 years and more about where each path could put me in 10–15 years.

Goals:

• €3–5M+ eventual net worth
• VP/SVP/CTO-level technology leadership
• Strong optionality for Big Tech later

Which would you take?

Especially interested in Google Cloud employees: how realistic is Advanced CE → internally apply for CE Manager → Director in Europe? Do strong senior CEs actually move into leadership, or do most remain ICs for many years?

We are being asked to RTO 5 days. Sure that seems to be the norm, I hate it but what can I do? I got bills to pay.

But what triggers me is they are implementing a tracking tool to monitor ENTRY AND EXIT TIMES, PLUS LUNCH/COFFEE BREAKS! HR email was sent out a few days ago announcing this and we have to talk to our managers about 'expectations or special circumstances'. WT actual F?

On top of that, PTO and travel aren’t even tracked properly yet. So I can take time off of work but I can't take a bathroom break and shit my pants at work.
